_fixture: A real Overpass answer for Times Square, recorded in two parts and merged. The roads and junction-control nodes are the original recording of the `way[highway]` / control-node half of `roadQuery` within ROAD_RADIUS. The 44 `building` ways and their nodes were appended later for the extruded city, recorded from the `way[building](around:150,40.7572614,-73.9858998)` half of the same query against a global Overpass mirror (overpass.openstreetmap.fr; the Kumi mirror the page uses was answering 504 "too busy" that day, which is exactly why this file exists). Nothing was edited: every element is as the API sent it. Overpass ignores unknown top-level keys and so does the parser, so this note rides along with the data it describes.
